title: Decentralised Batcher Framework with DAO governance

ms.promise:
・Architecture documentation: A detailed report that outlines the information flow and system requirements when:
・DAO members vote for batchers (issuing, revoking of licenses)
・Batchers fulfill orders (checking licenses)
・Licences are revoked/expire
・Licences are issued and distributed/claimed
・Smart contract infrastructure: Definition of the necessary smart contracts and their functionalities for assigning batcher rights to entities through issuance/revocation of licence tokens based on onchain governance.
ms.criteria:
・Documentation is easily understandable and concise. Further, it includes detailed information about the interaction with the Cardano blockchain and how non-technical users can interact with the smart contracts (in a later step this will be extended through the website interface) 
・Smart contract design is capable of assigning batching licenses to entities based on utility token governance (on-chain vote from staked tokens)
ms.report:
Hi, thank you for the feedback and for taking the time to review our submission. We have extended the report significantly to include more specifications and illustrations. We have also added more details about the two documents below and specified which acceptance criteria is addressed in each section of the report.
Report: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1kqG4Wf8VjNVmwgCyZfEtoaDSiz_7hWM5/view?usp=sharing
The report includes a general overview of how we plan to establish DAO governance through batchers, as well as the technical details of how this can be achieved. The answers to the acceptance criteria can be found in these sections:
・DAO members vote for batchers (issuing, revoking of licenses): Sections 2.1.2 and 2.1.3
・Batchers fulfill orders (checking licenses): Visualization in Section 2.1.1; technical details in Sections 3.5.1 and 3.5.2
・Licenses are revoked or expire: Explained as part of the smart contract framework in Sections 3.1–3.4
・Licenses are issued and distributed/claimed: Also explained as part of the smart contract framework in Sections 3.1–3.4

Moreover, the report outlines the technical framework for batcher monitoring, which we will deliver in the next milestone.
GitHub: https://github.com/MuesliSwapTeam/batcher-dao-governance
This repository includes the license consumer contract that allows for the creation of batcher licenses as an extension of our on-chain DAO platform. The README provides details on how to build the smart contracts. Additionally, we have included off-chain code and unit tests to verify that the smart contracts work, as well as an example of how a batcher can issue a license. The exact interplay of the different smart contract modules is described in Section 3.4 (technical details) of the report.
Please note: Based on the feedback from the reviewer we extended the GitHub Readme with additional instructions and included an Executive Summary in our report.

ms.promise:
・Preliminary front-end offering ability to vote on batchers
・Preliminary back-end that handles requests from front-end and interacts with smart contracts
・Fully developed smart contracts that handle governed batching rights via transactions initiated by the backend
ms.criteria:
・An instance of the front end is hosted and publicly available (accessible through the worldwide web) -
・On the frontend the user can vote on a batcher and see their vote stored on the blockchain - this will be shown on the interface with necessary explanation for the user
・Backend is sufficiently developed to handle voting. Further, backend documentation will be continuously updated so all API request and response schemas are known to the public.
・Smart contract is deployed onchain (preprod testnet) and is integrated successfully with the backend.

ms.promise:
・Front-end: Monitoring of various important metrics related to batching rights, such as spread distribution, total profit, volume. Clear indication to the user that the batcher is/is not aligned with their responsibilities under DAO governance.
・Back-end: Automatic tracking of transactions handled by the batcher, including parsing of information used to calculate the above and monitor batcher performance.
ms.criteria:
・Front-end is further built up to allow the user to easily monitor the activity of the batcher and assess their performance.
・Back-end is developed further to allow monitoring of the blockchain and provide endpoints to access the information related to batcher performance. Provided documentation should make this capability clear.
ms.report:
Dear Reviewers,
Please find the documents for our PoA below. We have released the new testnet frontend, which includes the Matchmaker governance and monitoring features, available at: https://preprod.dao.muesliswap.com
We have also created detailed GitBook documentation for the DAO Matchmaker features, available here https://docs.muesliswap.com/dao/matchmaker-governance
The documentation includes the following subpages:
・DAO Matchmaker Voting: https://docs.muesliswap.com/dao/matchmaker-governance/matchmaker-voting
・DAO Matchmaker Monitoring: https://docs.muesliswap.com/dao/matchmaker-governance/matchmaker-monitoring

Moreover, we have made the code public through two separate repositories. First, we developed an analytics backend to actively monitor and analyze all data. This code, along with our voting smart contract, is available here: https://github.com/MuesliSwapTeam/batcher-dao-governance/tree/main/dao-monitoring-backend
For your convenience, we have also deployed this backend (including endpoint documentation) here: https://dao-batcher-monitoring.muesliswap.com/docs
For the frontend, we integrated the Matchmaker functionality into our open-source DAO frontend. A dedicated release containing this functionality can be found in the branch release/matchmaker. https://github.com/MuesliSwapTeam/dao-governance-dashboard/tree/release/matchmaker
As mentioned, this version is deployed at https://preprod.dao.muesliswap.com using the batcher monitoring analytics backend shared above.
Thank you very much.
Best Regards,
MuesliSwap Team
